title: 第22章 柳溪镇
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
黄土路上，马蹄踩踏起滚滚烟尘。

    五名陈家骑卒扬长而去，目标直指镇中心。

    陈凡站在路边，挥袖拂去身前尘土，面色平静。

    在这种地方，越是刻意躲避，反而越容易落在有心人眼中。

    他如今顶着一张蜡黄的中年面容，修为炼气八层，任谁看都只是一个普通散修。

    他缀在骑卒后方约莫百丈远，不紧不慢地走进了柳溪镇。

    镇子里的凡人商贩见怪不怪，纷纷避让。

    那五名骑卒一路狂奔到周氏铁匠铺前，翻身下马，其中一人拿出一张有些揉巴的布告，粗暴地贴在铁匠铺大门旁的土墙上。

    “周铁匠，陈仙师府上的布告，看好了！”

    为首的骑卒大声呵斥，“这几日若有年龄在二十以下、生面孔的金灵根年轻修士过路，立刻去郡城兵马司通报！若是知情不报，你这铺子就别开了！”

    铁匠铺里走出一个皮肤黝黑的粗壮汉子，正是周铁匠。

    他脸上堆起谄媚的笑容，连连点头哈腰：“几位军爷放心，小人明白，明白。有消息一定第一时间报上去。”

    说着，周铁匠熟练地从柜台里摸出两块下品灵石，塞进了领头骑卒的手里。

    那骑卒掂了掂灵石，脸色好看了一些，冷哼一声，带着人朝着镇外另一处方向巡逻去了。

    他们不过是陈家凡人产业下的狗腿子，修仙资质低下，平日里多是在凡人城镇打秋风，根本没有半分真正的尽职心思。

    陈凡将这一切收入眼底。

    他走到布告前瞥了一眼，上面画的依旧是林渊那张模糊的画像。

    陈凡心中冷笑，迈步走进了铁匠铺。

    炉火熊熊，周铁匠正准备回炉打铁，瞧见一个皮肤蜡黄的中年散修走进来，便停下动作，冷淡道：“客官，打农具还是防身短刀？小店概不赊账。”

    陈凡走到柜台前，右手食指在木质柜面上轻轻敲击了三下，发出一阵有规律的闷响。

    他看着周铁匠，用改变后的沙哑声线开口：“要一把能斩玄铁的刀。”

    周铁匠瞳孔微微一缩，握着铁锤的手指紧了紧，随即面色如常地接话道：“玄铁没有，精铁三百文。”

    暗号正确。

    这是老祖记忆中，云国黑市在青阳郡外围眼线的通用对接暗号。

    周铁匠正是这个情报网络中的一个微小节点。

    周铁匠放下铁锤，在围裙上擦了擦手，换上了一副客气的神色：“客官里面请，后院有上好的精铁胚子，您随我去挑挑。”

    陈凡跟着周铁匠穿过前厅，来到了铁匠铺的后院。

    一进后院，周铁匠将厚重的木门插上，对着陈凡抱了抱拳，压低声音道：

    “道友面生得很，是从大泽那边过来的？如今青阳郡查得紧，陈、刘两家跟疯了似的，四处抓捕林家的余孽，道友这个时候走凡人路子，可得小心些。”

    “临泉郡散修，陈凡。”

    陈凡报上了自己的新名字，“路过此地，打算在柳溪镇租住一段时日。需要一个绝对安全且不受凡人打扰的地方。”

    周铁匠仔细打量了陈凡两眼，见对方气息在炼气八层，面色冷漠得不像是好惹的散修，便点头道：

    “规矩你懂。有一处独立的小院，位于镇西最偏僻的死胡同里，后面紧挨着荒山，有密道直通山里。若是遇到搜查，随时能走。月租，五块下品灵石，不二价。”

    “可。”

    陈凡没有废话，直接从怀中摸出五块下品灵石递了过去。

    周铁匠收了灵石，脸色顿时变得热切起来，从腰间解下一把铜钥匙递给陈凡：“出了铺子往西走三里，门前有棵枯柳树的就是。那地方平日里没人去，绝对安全。”

    陈凡接过钥匙，没有多留，转身离去。

    半刻钟后，陈凡站在了镇西的独立小院中。

    小院确实偏僻，四周怪石嶙峋，凡人极少涉足。

    院内只有三间青砖瓦房，落满了灰尘。
content_en:
On the loess road, horse hooves kicked up smoke and dust.

    The five Chen family cavalrymen walked away, aiming directly at the center of the town.

    Chen Fan stood on the side of the road, waving his sleeves to brush away the dust in front of him, with a calm expression.

    In a place like this, the more you deliberately avoid it, the easier it is for you to fall into the eyes of someone who is interested.

    He now has a sallow middle-aged face and is at the eighth level of Qi Refining. To anyone, he is just an ordinary cultivator.

    He stayed about a hundred feet behind the cavalry and walked into Liuxi Town unhurriedly.

    The mortal traders in the town were not surprised and all gave way.

    The five cavalrymen ran all the way to Zhou's blacksmith shop, got off their horses, and one of them took out a somewhat crumpled notice and roughly posted it on the earthen wall next to the door of the blacksmith shop.

    "Tiejiang Zhou, pay attention to the notice in Master Chen's house!"

    The leading cavalryman yelled loudly, "If there is a young monk from Jinlinggen who is under twenty years old and has an unfamiliar face passing by in the past few days, go to the military and horse department of the county and report it immediately! If you don't report the information, your shop will be closed!"

    A thick, dark-skinned man walked out of the blacksmith shop, it was Blacksmith Zhou.

    A flattering smile appeared on his face, and he nodded and bowed: "Don't worry, military lords, I understand, I understand. If there is any news, I will report it as soon as possible."

    With that said, Blacksmith Zhou skillfully took out two low-grade spiritual stones from the counter and put them into the hands of the leading cavalryman.

    The cavalryman weighed the spirit stone, his face looked better, he snorted coldly, and led his men to patrol in another direction outside the town.

    They are just the lackeys of the Chen family's mortal estate, with low qualifications for cultivating immortals. They usually spend their days playing in the mortal towns and have no real intention to fulfill their duties.

    Chen Fan took all this into consideration.

    He walked to the notice and glanced at it. The blurry portrait of Lin Yuan was still painted on it.

    Chen Fan sneered in his heart and walked into the blacksmith shop.

    The fire was blazing, and Blacksmith Zhou was about to go back to the furnace to strike iron. When he saw a middle-aged casual cultivator with sallow skin walking in, he stopped and said coldly: "Sir, are you looking for farm tools or self-defense daggers? This shop does not accept credit."

    Chen Fan walked to the counter and tapped his right index finger on the wooden counter three times, making a regular muffled sound.

    He looked at Blacksmith Zhou and spoke in a changed hoarse voice: "I want a knife that can cut black iron."

    Blacksmith Zhou's pupils shrank slightly, his fingers holding the hammer tightened, and then he continued with a normal expression: "There is no black iron, three hundred coins of fine iron."

    The password is correct.

    This is the common code used by the Yun Kingdom's black market agents in the peripheral Qingyang County in the ancestor's memory.

    Zhou Tiejiang is just a tiny node in this intelligence network.

    Blacksmith Zhou put down the hammer, wiped his hands on his apron, and put on a polite expression: "Please come in, sir. There are fine iron embryos in the backyard. You can pick them out with me."

    Chen Fan followed Blacksmith Zhou through the front hall and arrived at the backyard of the blacksmith shop.

    As soon as he entered the backyard, Blacksmith Zhou locked the heavy wooden door, clasped his fists towards Chen Fan, and said in a low voice:

    "Fellow Taoist is very handsome. Are you from Daze? Now Qingyang County is investigating very closely. The Chen and Liu families are going crazy, arresting the remnants of the Lin family. You should be careful when you follow the path of a mortal at this time."

    "Linquan County Loose Cultivator, Chen Fan."

    Chen Fan reported his new name, "I'm passing by here and plan to rent it in Liuxi Town for a while. I need a place that is absolutely safe and will not be disturbed by mortals."

    Blacksmith Zhou looked at Chen Fan carefully and saw that his aura was at the eighth level of Qi Refining, and his expression was too cold to look like a casual cultivator who was easy to mess with, so he nodded and said:

    "You know the rules. There is an independent small courtyard, located in the most remote dead end in the west of the town. Behind it is a barren mountain. There is a secret road leading directly to the mountain. If there is a search, you can leave at any time. The monthly rent is five pieces of low-grade spiritual stones, no two prices."

    "Yes."

    Chen Fan didn't waste any time. He took out five low-grade spiritual stones from his arms and handed them over.

    After receiving the spirit stone, Blacksmith Zhou's face suddenly became eager. He took off a copper key from his waist and handed it to Chen Fan: "After leaving the shop, walk three miles to the west. There is a dead willow tree in front of the door. No one goes there on weekdays, so it is absolutely safe."

    Chen Fan took the key, turned around and left without staying long.

    Half a quarter of an hour later, Chen Fan stood in a small independent courtyard in the west of the town.

    The small courtyard is indeed remote, surrounded by rugged rocks, and few mortals set foot there.

    There are only three green brick houses in the courtyard, which are covered with dust.
